# Hronaut support

Choose the path that matches what you need.

## Connect Hronaut

Start Hronaut and use the configuration shown on **Hronaut Home** for your coding agent. It reflects the current local endpoint and authentication settings; do not guess a port or paste an MCP token into a public issue.

- Follow the [setup guide](https://hronaut.dev/setup) for supported clients and connection checks.
- After connecting, use the [starter workflows](../STARTER_WORKFLOWS.md) for a safe first browser task, authenticated handoff, localhost QA, or responsive review.
- Share a successful or unsuccessful connection through the structured [setup feedback form](https://github.com/hronaut/hronaut/issues/new?template=setup-feedback.yml).

## Report a product defect

Search [existing issues](https://github.com/hronaut/hronaut/issues) first. If the behavior is new, use the structured [bug report form](https://github.com/hronaut/hronaut/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml) with the smallest reproducible sequence and sanitized diagnostics.

Do not include credentials, MCP tokens, private URLs, page content, wallet material, personal data, screenshots containing private information, or raw browser-session logs in a public issue.

## Report a security vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Read the [security policy](SECURITY.md), then report the vulnerability privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/hronaut/hronaut/security/advisories/new).

## Billing and commercial licensing

Email [support@hronaut.dev](mailto:support@hronaut.dev). Do not send credentials, recovery phrases, private keys, or MCP tokens.
